name: @suveren/pairing
description: The device-keys logic the phone app and the gateway share, non-React: the pairing ceremony (plan 4.3: the mailbox, the check of the opened entry, the comparison-code choices, the device list) and the change confirmation (plan 7 phone path: the sealed view, the gateway's signed envelope, the phone's signed answer and both ends' checks). ONE implementation for the phone app (apps/approve) and the gateway's control plane. Source-only: the host's bundler compiles it. No DOM, no network, no storage.
